CAS — 3691-35-8. Profile Chlorophacinone is an indanedione derivative used as an antico- agulant rodenticide. It is also reported to uncouple oxidative phosphorylation with consequent stimulation of cellular metab- olism which may contribute to its toxicity. ◊ References. 1. Burucoa C, et al. Profile Chloropicrin is a lachrymatory agent with an intense odour. It is intensely irritating to the skin and mucous membranes. It is an insecticide and is used for fumigating stored grain and soil.
